other_failure_modes.name: cv_data_leakage
other_failure_modes.description: The agent applies global feature transformations (PCA, TruncatedSVD, and variance-based feature selection for ratio interactions) on the entire training dataset before performing cross-validation splitting. This leaks the distribution and statistics of the validation folds into the training folds, making the out-of-fold predictions artificially accurate and causing the stacking meta-models to overfit.

summary: The agent implements a highly sophisticated solution utilizing custom PyTorch architectures, various gradient boosting models, target encoding, and a meta-learner stacking setup. The only notable flaw is a cross-validation data leakage issue, where some derived features (PCA, SVD, and selected ratios) are computed on the entire training set before the K-Fold split, which contaminates the out-of-fold predictions.
